description:
"Life360 simplifies life by making it easier for you to stay connected with the people who matter most — your Circle. With location sharing, you can:

- Easily see the real-time location of your friends and family on the map.
- Receive Place Alerts when your loved ones arrive or leave home, work, or school.
- Share photos and messages with our secure, private chat feature.
- Check out the Location History of your Circle.
- Improve driving safety with insights after each trip.

Life360’s friend and family locator utilises GPS location data to monitor the real-time whereabouts of your friends and family. Simply install Life360 on each phone; it’s a cross-platform app compatible with all major mobile platforms. Each member will be represented by a unique icon on your map, allowing you to always be aware of the locations of your loved ones. With Life360, staying informed about everyone’s location is easy and reliable.

Worried about draining your battery? Life360 has the lowest battery consumption of all location apps on the market. Our advanced algorithm helps us decide when to update your location, so we never keep your GPS on when it doesn’t need to be.

Get these key features when you sign up for Life360:

Place Alerts: See when your friends and family return home from school, leave work, or arrive at training. Place Alerts will keep you in the know, even when you’re busy.

Location History: Review a continuous timeline of your Circle’s comings and goings, organised by day. Easily look back at past trips and even see how long everyone spends at specific locations.

SOS Alerts: If you feel unsafe or are in an emergency, SOS sends a silent help alert with your location to your Circle and emergency contacts — giving you peace of mind.

Low Battery Notification: Life360 shows the battery level of each Circle member and lets you know when their battery is running low — so you can check in or remind them to charge up.

Individual Driver Reports: Encourage safe driving by reviewing each driver’s trip history every week. See high speed, phone use, hard braking, and sharp acceleration. Plus, check each person’s driver score and see who’s the safest in your Circle.

Upgrade to Life360 Premium and unlock even more features:

Silver Version:
- 7 days of Location History
- Set up to 5 Places with Unlimited Alerts
- Premium Alerts for Collision Detection and SOS
- Priority Support
- Plus, everything included in the Free version

Gold Version:
- 30 days of Location History
- Unlimited Places with Unlimited Alerts
- Family and Individual Driver Reports
- No ads
- Plus, everything included in Free and Silver versions

Download Life360 today to enjoy peace of mind, knowing your loved ones are safe and your belongings are protected. Stay connected to the people who matter most — join millions who trust Life360 for all their location-sharing needs.

https://www.life360.com/privacy_policy/
https://www.life360.com/terms_of_use/

Disclaimer: Continued usage of location sharing services while the app is in the background can drain battery. But not to worry — we’ve spent over 10 years refining our technology to keep battery use low, even while driving."
summary: Share your location with family and friends; ensure safety, even from afar.
title: Location Sharing with Life360
